rich_summary: These sections recount the rise of Skanda (Kartikeya) as a divine war leader. Surrounded by gods, sages, planets, and fierce Mother goddesses, the young deity attracts the attention of Indra, who marches against him with the celestial army. When the gods attack, Skanda releases flames from his mouth that devastate their forces. Indra strikes him with the thunderbolt, but from the wound another powerful youth, Visakha, is born, terrifying the gods and forcing Indra to seek Skanda’s protection. The sages then urge Skanda to become ruler of the three worlds, yet he refuses Indra’s throne and instead accepts the role of commander of the celestial hosts. Honored by the gods and blessed with divine virtues, Skanda is anointed as the general who will lead the gods against the Danavas.

top_scenes.scene_text: The infant war‑god Skanda surrounded by fierce Mother goddesses and the fire‑god Agni, watching over him on a mountain.
Skanda roaring like the ocean as flames burst from his mouth, burning the charging celestial army of Indra.
Indra’s thunderbolt striking Skanda and from the wound a radiant warrior, Visakha, emerging with a club in hand.
